d8e7d08f67.q: What is Sauce Labs Aura's deterministic advantage over LLM-based test case generation?
d8e7d08f67.a: LLMs can generate test cases but produce non-deterministic results—every test case suite differs from the last based on the model's variability. Aura produces deterministic test suites or test harnesses that you can use repeatedly to measure quality consistently.
